0022600189.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-6) are 11th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central, and they are on a one-game winning streak into their 10th game of the season. The Denver Nuggets (4-3) are 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest, also on a one-game winning streak, and this NBA Mexico City Game is at a neutral site in Mexico City, with the Pacers as the designated home team. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Denver is without DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after Denver won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
